text: Brief Introduction: Qingdao Belt & Road Collaborative Training Institute is in cooperation with Qingdao International Academician Park (with more than 104 Academicians). Students joining this program have chance to attend the lectures held by Academicians in different fields, and excellent students can be assistants of academicians and professors to learn from the masters hand by hand. Introduction of Qingdao International Academician Park Qingdao International Academician Park is located in the south of World Expo Park, next to Ocean University of China. It is composed of 26 detached multistory buildings and 3 high-rise buildings. It covers an areas of 88 mu, with the building area of 196,000 square meters. It is a unique low-density, ecological and smart innovation park in central city area. Under the strategy of driving by innovation and giving priority to talents by CPC Licang District Committee and district government, this world-class, unprecedented academician park was founded, oriented towards online information, design and R&D, biological medicine, high-end equipment manufacturing as well as new energy and new materials.
